d2626082f4768d2e.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة المعيبد للتجاره عن حاجتها لمدير عمليات تشغيل (Chief Operating Officer - COO) للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة الإشراف المباشر على تخطيط وتنظيم عمليات تشغيل المعدات المختلفة، وضمان سير العمليات بأعلى مستويات الكفاءة والفعالية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تزيد عن 10 سنوات في المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في إعداد الخطط الاستراتيجية والتشغيلية لعمليات التشغيل، بما يتماشى مع التوجهات والأولويات المحددة. الإشراف المباشر على أعمال تخطيط وتنظيم تشغيل المعدات المتنوعة، ومتابعة تنفيذ التعليمات بما يتوافق مع الخطط التشغيلية. ضمان توافر كافة الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لسير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية. متابعة وإدارة وتوجيه الأنشطة المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات، وضمان التطبيق الأمثل للأنظمة واللوائح والتعليمات. متابعة عمليات إصدار التراخيص والتصاريح اللازمة، بما يتوافق مع المعايير والشروط المعتمدة. المشاركة في مراجعة وتطوير الأنظمة واللوائح والسياسات المتبعة في مجالات تشغيل المعدات، وضمان تحديثها المستمر. مراجعة ودراسة احتياجات المملكة من الخطوط الحديدية فيما يتعلق بالمعدات. متابعة عمليات إعداد وتحضير تقارير العمل والإنجاز، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا المتخصصة، وإحاطتها بالتحديات والمستجدات المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 10 سنوات في مجال إدارة عمليات التشغيل. فهم عميق للخطط الاستراتيجية والتشغيلية وإدارة تطبيقها. القدرة على إدارة وتوجيه أنشطة تشغيل المعدات بكفاءة. معرفة بالأنظمة واللوائح المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات وإصدار التراخيص. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإدارية قوية. القدرة على التخطيط والتنظيم الفعال. مهارات ممتازة في حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وعرضها على الإدارة العليا. مهارات التواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل يعمل مدير عمليات التشغيل في شركة المعيبد للتجاره بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع الإدارة العليا والفرق التشغيلية لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

d2811096f796ecfd.description: About Dar AlBalad Dar AlBalad is seeking a Financial Controller to join their team. This full-time position is available in both Riyadh and Jeddah, requiring over 10 years of relevant experience. The Role of Financial Controller The Financial Controller will be responsible for overseeing financial operations and ensuring the integrity of financial reporting. This role involves managing financial controls, budgeting, and cash flow, contributing to the financial health and strategic direction of the company. Key Responsibilities Implementing and maintaining robust financial controls. Managing budgeting processes and financial forecasting. Overseeing cash flow management and optimization. Ensuring compliance with IFRS and contract accounting standards (IFRS 15). Applying project costing methodologies effectively. Utilizing ERP systems for advanced financial analysis and reporting. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline. CPA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent certification is preferred. 8–12+ years of finance experience, with at least 3–5 years in financial controlling or a senior finance management position. Experience in O&M, industrial services, EPC, oil & gas, power generation, or related project-based businesses is strongly preferred. Required Skills Strong knowledge of IFRS, contract accounting (IFRS 15), project costing, budgeting, financial controls, and cash flow management. Proficiency in ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent. Advanced financial analysis capabilities. Demonstrated leadership, analytical, communication, and business partnering skills. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time Financial Controller position in Riyadh or Jeddah.

d2436a3a4906da99.company_name: شركة زاد المودة لتجارة المواد الغذائية
d2436a3a4906da99.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زاد المودة لتجارة المواد الغذائية عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وضمان دقة تسجيل المبيعات، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عدّ المبالغ المالية وتسجيلها في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، والتأكد من توافر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو الطرق الأخرى المعتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أية اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل مع العملاء بترحيب وتلبية رغباتهم فيما يتعلق بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المبالغ المالية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل يعمل موظف الصندوق في بيئة تجزئة ديناميكية في المدينة المنورة، ضمن فريق شركة زاد المودة لتجارة المواد الغذائية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمواعيد العمل المحددة. ملخص الوظيفة يقوم موظف الصندوق بإدارة العمليات المالية اليومية، بما في ذلك عد النقود، استلام المدفوعات، تحديث الأسعار، وتسوية المبيعات. كما يتولى مسؤولية التعامل مع طلبات العملاء لضمان رضاهم. هذا الدور أساسي لضمان سير العمليات المالية بسلاسة ودقة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

d21d86092cef9de8.description: About Alfanar Projects Alfanar Projects is seeking an experienced OHTL Designer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is essential for ensuring the effective execution of projects and the development of team capabilities. Role Overview The OHTL Designer will be responsible for leading and developing a team, ensuring tasks are distributed fairly, and meeting operational and development targets. The role involves effective resource utilization, problem resolution, and adherence to quality and safety standards. Key Responsibilities Train subordinates and build an effective team. Provide leadership, coaching, and direction to subordinates in all aspects of their work. Delegate assignments to subordinates. Ensure fair distribution of tasks to maintain morale and motivation among subordinates. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets as per delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Resolve any related problems that arise and escalate complex operational issues. Ensure quality requirements are met to develop effective quality control and processes, including specifications for products, processes, or related activities. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, and procedures, seeking automation opportunities where possible. Comply with related policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within the defined area of work activity to guarantee safety, legislative compliance, and delivery of high-quality products/services. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in OHTL design or a similar field. The ability to lead a team and manage project deliverables is crucial for this role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. The role requires a proactive approach to team leadership and project management within a dynamic environment.

d2941b8abc643fa7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة جلسان للمقاولات عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة المتعلقة بدوام الموظفين وإجازاتهم، بالإضافة إلى التعامل مع استفساراتهم وشكواهم بمهنية عالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم بأنواعها المختلفة، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات والإعارة وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، بما في ذلك تسجيل وتوثيق الترقيات والدورات التدريبية والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في التعامل مع الموظفين وحل المشكلات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل أخصائي عمليات الموارد البشرية ضمن فريق ديناميكي لدعم العمليات اليومية للموارد البشرية في الشركة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة جلسان للمقاولات.

d20cbe3794a305c6.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking a highly experienced and results-driven Sales Head – Diesel Generators to lead and expand its generator business across Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is available in Dammam, Jeddah, and Riyadh, with a salary range of SAR 15,000 to SAR 20,000 per month. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth, developing new business opportunities, managing key accounts, and leading the sales team to achieve revenue and profitability objectives. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue and profitability targets. Lead the sales and service team, driving business development across sectors including Oil & Gas, Construction, Industrial, Infrastructure, Data Centers, Rental, and Government. Develop and maintain relationships with key customers, consultants, contractors, and EPC companies. Manage major projects, tenders, negotiations, and key accounts. Provide technical guidance on power solutions. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing strategies, and new business opportunities. Coordinate with engineering, service, and operations teams to ensure customer satisfaction. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in sales leadership within the diesel generator industry. This role requires a professional with a proven track record of achieving sales targets and expanding market presence. Required Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in a relevant sales leadership role, specifically within the diesel generator sector. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Saudi Arabia, with opportunities in Dammam, Jeddah, and Riyadh. The role involves working within a dynamic team focused on expanding the company's market share in the power solutions industry. Compensation The salary for this position ranges from SAR 15,000 to SAR 20,000 per month, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

d26247a0a6c04811.description: About the Role SFCL (Specialized Facilities Company Limited) is seeking a Project Coordinator for future facilities management coordination opportunities. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires a professional who can effectively coordinate with service providers in France and communicate professionally in French. Role Overview The Project Coordinator will play a key role in ensuring seamless communication and operational efficiency between various stakeholders. This involves coordinating activities between management in Riyadh, local operational teams, contractors, and international service providers, particularly those based in France. Key Responsibilities Coordinate effectively between management in Riyadh, operational teams, contractors, and overseas service providers. Track maintenance requests, work orders, and deadlines, ensuring timely escalation of any delays or risks. Follow up on maintenance schedules, site visits, and inspections, and collect comprehensive completion reports. Prepare detailed operational reports, meeting minutes, and updates on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Follow up on quotations, purchase requests, and invoices, verifying all supporting documentation. Maintain accurate records of contractor certifications and insurance, including tracking expiry dates. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience in project coordination or facilities management. Ability to communicate professionally in French is essential for coordinating with service providers in France. Strong organizational and communication skills. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position located in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires on-site presence to facilitate coordination and oversight of facilities management activities. Application Process SFCL invites interested candidates to express their interest in this Project Coordinator role. Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon initial contact.

d275b5b86cb64393.description: About the Role Nokia KSA is seeking a Regional Technology Specialist for Mission Critical & Enterprise (MC-E) to join its Technology Strategy team. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and serves as a critical link between global technology strategy, domain expertise, and customer-facing Sales and Pre-Sales organizations across the Middle East and Africa Region. The role requires broad technological depth across mission-critical domains including energy, utilities, transportation, rail, public sector, defense, research, and education. Role Purpose and Scope The Regional Technology Specialist understands common technology requirements, architectural patterns, operational challenges, and emerging trends within these industries, translating them into relevant solutions for regional customers. This position complements deep vertical expertise with a broader end-to-end technology and architecture perspective, connecting customer requirements with appropriate technologies, solutions, architectures, and capabilities across the portfolio. The objective is to enable Sales and Pre-Sales teams to engage customers earlier and more strategically, develop stronger solution architectures, accelerate complex opportunities, and effectively position the MC-E portfolio. Key Responsibilities Partner with Sales and Pre-Sales teams to support opportunity qualification, solution architecture, and technical positioning across Mission Critical & Enterprise domains. Lead customer discovery sessions, architecture workshops, technical presentations, executive briefings, and competitive discussions. Support RFI/RFP responses, solution demonstrations, proof-of-concept planning, and strategic pursuits. Translate customer business and technology requirements into compelling solution architectures and value propositions. Gather and analyze customer, partner, market, and competitive insights, converting findings into actionable recommendations. Contribute to technology strategy by developing business cases, supporting roadmap discussions, and providing market-driven requirements. Act as a liaison between regional teams and global technology strategy functions, communicating portfolio direction, best practices, and technology updates. Provide competitive intelligence, field-readiness input, and technical enablement assets to strengthen customer engagement and drive growth across the region. Qualifications and Experience 8-10 years of experience in a relevant technology role. Demonstrated broad, horizontal technology depth across mission-critical domains. Ability to understand common technology requirements, architectural patterns, operational challenges, and emerging trends. Experience in supporting strategic customer engagements, including workshops and technical discussions. Strong capability in shaping solution architectures and technical value propositions. Benefits Flexible and hybrid working schemes. Minimum of 90 days of Maternity and Paternity Leave, with options for extended return-to-work periods (based on eligibility). Life insurance for financial security. Well-being programs supporting mental and physical health. Opportunities to join and receive support from Nokia Employee Resource Groups (NERGs). Employee Growth Solutions for personalized career and skills development. Access to a diverse pool of Coaches & Mentors. A learning environment that promotes personal growth and professional development. Application Process Candidates interested in this role are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d2c8fa69d2d27a0e.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Project Controls Manager to join its team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with projects located in Taif and Makkah. This full-time position involves leading a team of professionals in overseeing all phases of critical projects, focusing on planning, scheduling, and cost analysis. The role requires a versatile professional with strong communication, analytical, and management skills to address complex construction challenges. Key Responsibilities Provide guidance and specialized assistance to projects for resolving complex project control issues. Interface with clients, attend regular meetings, and prepare statistical reports. Manage a team of Project Control Engineers/Specialists responsible for analyzing, evaluating, and forecasting project costs and performance against established schedules and critical milestones. Assess the impact of design/construction changes and schedule slippages. Oversee the development and maintenance of a system to display the hierarchy of plans and schedules, ensuring project and company management are fully informed. Coordinate staffing requirements, assign and supervise project work activities, and provide training to personnel. Complete performance reviews and facilitate personnel development for assigned employees. Recommend and oversee the customization of project control systems to meet specific project requirements. Create statistical reports for management on a recurring or ad-hoc basis. Participate in business development efforts by gathering and presenting background data. Deliver informal or formal presentations as required. Perform other associated responsibilities as appropriate. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in project controls activities. Demonstrated experience in managing small to medium-sized projects. Extensive experience and exposure to various types of projects and clients. Must meet Parsons Project Controls Manager Certification requirements. Skills and Attributes Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal. Strong analytical abilities for evaluating project performance and costs. Proven management skills to lead and develop a team of professionals. Versatility in applying diversified knowledge of project controls activities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, with work locations including Taif and Makkah. The role involves working on complex construction problems that contribute significantly to the local community. Career Development Parsons offers opportunities for career advancement for top performers, leveraging extensive experience in the field combined with individual management and technical expertise.

d2cb88e896c9475c.description: About the Role Saudi Air Navigation Services (SANS) is seeking an R&D Automation Systems Engineer to join their team in Jeddah. This full-time role is focused on supporting R&D initiatives for next-generation Air Traffic Management (ATM) systems, ensuring they align with SANS operational needs for safe, efficient, scalable, and cyber-resilient Air Traffic Control services. Role Purpose and Context The primary purpose of this role is to contribute to and support R&D initiatives related to the deployment of advanced ATM systems. This involves analyzing and documenting complex requirements, participating in vendor evaluations, and supporting the testing and validation of cloud-native, Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) platforms. The engineer will ensure systems meet SANS operational needs within defined KPIs, budgets, and adopted policies. Key Responsibilities Support the development of the SANS Engineering Masterplan for ATM Automation systems, capturing and addressing needs at strategic and business planning milestones. Define, document, and maintain ATM systems requirements and Scope of Works (SOWs), ensuring alignment with approved architecture standards, interoperability, international masterplans (*, SESAR, FAA), and regulatory requirements. Assist in assessing the impact of changes in ATS procedures and airspace structure on ATM systems using Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) frameworks. Coordinate with other ANSPs for technical interfacing integration and communication, focusing on SWIM and interoperability protocols (AIXM, FIXM, WXXM). Participate in and introduce Working Papers at international and regional conferences and ICAO panels related to ATM systems. Coordinate with SANS Departments to ensure compatibility of ATM systems designs with current and future CNS/ATM systems and infrastructure, adhering to transversal constraints such as Safety, Cybersecurity, Human Factors, and Network Performance. Participate in system (SDR), preliminary (PDR), and critical (CDR) design review meetings. Conduct technical evaluations of prospective ATM Automation system vendors, assessing compliance against requirements and maturity in delivering cloud-native microservices. Develop, maintain, and analyze Vendor Scorecards tracking KPIs such as Reliability, Availability, and Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR). Participate in reviewing technical proposals for CNS systems, ensuring solutions avoid vendor lock-in and align with the ANSP's strategic roadmap. Participate in R&D validations, ATM system testing, commissioning, and hand-over of projects, ensuring delivered systems meet specifications and performance. Support maintenance activities of ATM systems and monitor on-site activities to ensure completion as per agreed specifications and quality standards. Participate in the analysis of systems trouble reports (STRs) and conduct required modification programs and systems change processes (SCPs). Advise the ATM Systems Chief on any potential impact of ongoing projects on ATC service delivery. Conduct day-to-day activities in compliance with policies and procedures. Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement of systems and processes. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of relevant experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, focusing on critical infrastructure development within the air navigation services sector. Application Information Further details regarding the application process and salary will be provided to qualified candidates.

d2e1c7c1db0bc728.description: About Duedent Dental Lab and the Role Duedent Dental Lab, located in Makkah and Jeddah, is seeking a Senior Accountant to join its expanding team. This full-time position is critical for maintaining financial accuracy and supporting the company's growth within the dental laboratory sector. Key Responsibilities Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable processes. Oversee budgeting activities and financial reconciliations. Ensure accurate bookkeeping and financial reporting. Apply strong knowledge of accounting principles in daily operations. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of relevant accounting experience. Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel. Required Skills Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Good communication skills. Ability to work independently. Solid understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting, and bookkeeping. Preferred Qualifications Priority will be given to Saudi nationals. Previous experience in a dental laboratory or healthcare-related industry. Application Process Candidates meeting the above requirements are encouraged to apply for this Senior Accountant position at Duedent Dental Lab.

d231c2c049400677.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الموارد الطبية عن مدير صيدلة للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة القصيم، وتحديداً في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. سيشرف مدير الصيدلة على العمليات اليومية ويضمن تقديم خدمات صيدلانية عالية الجودة وفقاً للمعايير واللوائح المعمول بها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى مدير الصيدلة مجموعة من المهام الإشرافية والتشغيلية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية، وتشمل: الإشراف على تنظيم وتشغيل الخدمات الصيدلانية لضمان تلقي المرضى الأدوية المناسبة لاحتياجاتهم العلاجية والوقائية، بما يتوافق مع المعايير الدولية. متابعة الأداء العام للكادر الصيدلاني والإشراف على الخطط التشغيلية، مع تقديم تقارير دورية حول الأداء للمعنيين وفق نظام إدارة الأداء المعتمد. الإشراف على تخطيط وتطوير ممارسة مهنة الصيدلة، ووضع الأنظمة والمعايير والضوابط والسياسات التي تحكمها، بما يتماشى مع الأهداف الاستراتيجية لوزارة الصحة وأفضل الممارسات العالمية. الإشراف على إصدار اللوائح والأوامر والنظم والدلائل الإرشادية الخاصة بالصيدلة، واقتراح السياسة الدوائية، وتحديث وتوحيد جميع السياسات والإجراءات المتعلقة بالصيدليات. الإشراف على إعداد ورفع تقارير دورية كمية ونوعية حول استهلاك المرافق الصحية للأدوية. المهام التشغيلية بالإضافة إلى المهام الإشرافية، يضطلع مدير الصيدلة بمسؤوليات تشغيلية يومية لضمان جودة الخدمة، ومنها: الإشراف على العمليات اليومية داخل الصيدلية وضمان سير العمل بكفاءة عالية. صرف الأدوية للمرضى وفقاً للوصفات الطبية، والتأكد من مطابقة الجرعات والإرشادات. متابعة المخزون وإدارة طلبات الأدوية والمستلزمات لضمان توفرها بشكل مستمر. الالتزام بالأنظمة والتعليمات الصادرة عن وزارة الصحة والجهات الرقابية. تقديم المشورة الدوائية والإرشادات الطبية للمرضى حول الاستخدام الصحيح للأدوية. الإشراف على فريق العمل في الصيدلية (صيدلي مساعد، فنيين، كاشير)، وتوزيع المهام، ومتابعة الأداء. إعداد تقارير دورية عن المبيعات، المخزون، والالتزام باللائحة الداخلية وكافة اللوائح والتشريعات المتعلقة بممارسة المهنة. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيدلة أو إدارة الصيدليات. معرفة قوية بالأنظمة والتعليمات الصادرة عن وزارة الصحة والجهات الرقابية. مهارات قيادية وإشرافية ممتازة لإدارة فريق العمل. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتحليل البيانات المتعلقة بالعمليات الصيدلانية. بيئة العمل سيعمل مدير الصيدلة بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية في شركة الموارد الطبية، مع التركيز على تقديم رعاية صحية متميزة في منطقة القصيم، وتحديداً في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

d2c90ad9f4f280f9.description: مقدمة عن الوظيفة تعلن شركة فهد عبدالرحمن الرشيد القابضة، وهي شركة مساهمة سعودية، عن حاجتها لمساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريق عملها في مدينة الرياض. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير فرص عمل متساوية، مع تركيز خاص على دمج وتمكين ذوي الإعاقة، وتسعى لخلق بيئة عمل داعمة ومنتجة للجميع. نبذة عن الدور يتولى المساعد الإداري مسؤولية دعم العمليات اليومية في مقر الشركة، ويشمل ذلك التعامل مع المهام المكتبية والإدارية المتنوعة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية، والمساهمة في توفير بيئة عمل منظمة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ المهام الإدارية والمكتبية اليومية بفعالية. المساهمة في تنظيم سير العمل وتنسيق الأنشطة المختلفة. التعامل مع المراسلات والوثائق الإدارية. المؤهلات والمتطلبات امتلاك مهارات إدارية وتنظيمية جيدة. القدرة على التعامل مع المهام المكتبية والإدارية المتنوعة. خبرة في استخدام برامج مايكروسوفت أوفيس (وورد، إكسل، باوربوينت وغيرها). مهارات تواصل ممتازة والقدرة على التعامل بفعالية مع الآخرين. الاستعداد للعمل في بيئة ديناميكية ومتغيرة. بيئة العمل تلتزم شركة فهد عبدالرحمن الرشيد القابضة بتوفير بيئة عمل شاملة وداعمة، مع التركيز على دمج ذوي الإعاقة وتوفير فرص متساوية للجميع. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مقر الشركة بالرياض. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم لهذه الفرصة في شركة فهد عبدالرحمن الرشيد القابضة.

The company's technologies support the translation of scientific discoveries into medicine, aiming to deliver new therapeutics to patients worldwide. Sartorius is listed on the MDAX and TecDAX. This full-time position is based in the company's local Headquarters in Riyadh, with opportunities for home office work. Organize appointments, conferences, and travels; plan events; make travel arrangements; and create travel expense reports. Coordinate meetings with senior government officials, customers, and partners. Interface with KAFD service-office providers. Prepare documents and presentation materials; screen and respond to incoming correspondence, inquiries, and phone calls; draft letters and official information releases; arrange and attend meetings; and take and distribute meeting minutes. d202f6d93e79be03.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة أشجار كرز القهوة لتقديم الوجبات عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يركز هذا الدور على وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير المتخصصة في مجال المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق، وتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع الزبائن لتحديد مشكلاتهم، ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية. تقييم أداء مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تحليل السوق وتحديد الأهداف البيعية. مهارات تواصل قوية للتفاعل مع الزبائن والمنافسين. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

d20dbcd614b79226.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن حاجتها لطبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في محايل، عسير. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تقييم تطور الحالات وفاعلية العلاج المقدم. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية المفصلة من المريض وذويه، وإجراء الفحص السريري الشامل. طلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى الصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية، وقراءة وتفسير النتائج والتقارير المتعلقة بها. تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ضمن موضوع التخصص الطبي. وضع خطط علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها بفعالية. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية ومدى استجابتها للخطة العلاجية المتبعة. إعداد وتوثيق التقارير والسجلات الطبية المتعلقة بالمرضى وحفظها وفقاً للمعايير المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التخصص الطبي. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وذويهم. الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية والأخلاقية في ممارسة الطب. نوع الوظيفة وموقع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة محايل بمنطقة عسير. يبحث فريق صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن محترفين ملتزمين لتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

d213c655ab322e98.description: About the Role: Solutions Engineer Napster is seeking a Solutions Engineer for a full-time position in Saudi Arabia. This role is responsible for identifying and validating technically feasible solutions to prospect problems, ensuring they are ready for deal closure. Reporting to the Head of Solutions Engineering, the Solutions Engineer leads technical discovery, defines problems and desired outcomes, and develops product-aligned solution concepts for handover to the Delivery team. The position requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Lead technical discovery with prospects to uncover business problems, current states, and desired outcomes. Translate customer needs into solution mental models, demonstrating how an AI agent would solve problems using Napster's platform, and validate high-level feasibility. Build and present demos and proofs of concept that showcase proposed solutions delivering business value. Serve as the primary technical resource for customers throughout the sales cycle, addressing product, API, and LLM-related questions, providing architecture recommendations, and handling objections. Develop and maintain strong customer relationships and trust during the evaluation, validation, and purchasing process. Address initial security and compliance questions, explain standardized collateral, guide customers to relevant resources, and escalate complex requirements. Gather and relay customer feedback internally, identify common themes, and contribute to product planning. Documentation and Handoff Create and maintain documentation, guides, and FAQs based on common pre-sales questions and requirements. Package validated solution concepts, architecture notes, and discovery context for a clean handoff to Delivery upon deal signing. Participate in the formal Sales-to-Delivery handoff to confirm no open gaps exist. Remain available during the initial build phase for questions regarding original solution intent and provide lessons learned to Solutions Engineering leadership. Required Experience and Skills 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Strong consultative and technically fluent capabilities. Accountability for technical feasibility and solution architecture during the pre-sales stage. Genuine interest in AI capabilities and willingness to deeply understand customer problems, Napster's platform, and technical trade-offs. Demonstrated customer empathy. Ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Delivery/Professional Services, and Product teams. Performance Measures Win rate and deal progression on opportunities where the Solutions Engineer led discovery and solution design. Statement of Work (SOW)-to-actual variance and rework rate. Clean handoff rate to Delivery. Time-to-validate feasibility on new opportunities. Prospect and customer feedback on technical credibility during the sales cycle. Company Culture Napster Corp values impact, fostering a vibrant team culture that promotes creativity and collaboration. The company offers a dynamic environment for growth and provides competitive compensation, equity opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. Napster Corp embraces diversity and provides equal opportunity for all applicants and employees, aiming to build a company that reflects a global audience.

d26aadd48e92a69f.description: About the Role Aventus Global Talent is seeking an Investment Banking Director to join an established investment bank's growing team in Riyadh. This full-time role is for a senior investment banking professional with over 10 years of experience, focusing on the development of the firm's M&A franchise in Saudi Arabia. The position combines client origination, transaction execution, and senior stakeholder relationship management. Role Overview The successful candidate will be responsible for leading M&A activities, developing new client relationships, identifying strategic opportunities, and managing complex mandates across various sectors. This role considers professionals with experience in traditional investment banking advisory, as well as those who have originated transactions from a corporate or institutional balance sheet. Candidates with EMEA market experience are encouraged to apply. Key Responsibilities Lead the origination of M&A mandates and develop relationships with corporates, family groups, financial sponsors, and sovereign-backed entities across Saudi Arabia and the wider region. Manage end-to-end execution of M&A transactions, including mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, and strategic advisory mandates. Establish and maintain senior-level relationships with C-suite executives, board members, shareholders, and key decision-makers. Provide strategic advice on corporate transactions, valuation, deal structuring, negotiations, and transaction strategy. Contribute to the expansion of the firm's M&A franchise in Saudi Arabia, identify new opportunities, and support regional presence development. Collaborate with transaction teams, mentor junior bankers, and work with senior management to deliver client outcomes. Leverage international experience and relationships to identify and execute cross-border opportunities, particularly within the EMEA region. Candidate Requirements Over 10 years of extensive experience in M&A investment banking, corporate finance advisory, or a closely related transaction-focused role. Demonstrable experience in both M&A origination and transaction execution, with the ability to independently develop client relationships and convert them into mandates. A strong track record of leading complex transactions and managing senior client relationships. Sector-agnostic experience, with the ability to advise across multiple industries and identify opportunities beyond a single sector specialism. Experience gained within an investment bank, advisory boutique, or relevant corporate or institutional environment. Candidates with a proven track record of originating transactions from a corporate or institutional balance sheet will also be considered. Previous experience covering EMEA markets, including Europe, the Middle East, and/or Africa, is preferred. Existing relationships across Saudi Arabia or the wider Middle East are advantageous. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this full-time Investment Banking Director position in Riyadh. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d2478e3decb3775f.description: About the Role Middle East Mattress Factory Co. (Sealy Mattress Middle East) is seeking an Operations Manager to oversee manufacturing and plant operations at its facility in Jeddah, Makkah Province. This full-time role is central to aligning daily factory operations with corporate business goals, optimizing resource utilization, and leading multi-cultural teams. The Operations Manager will focus on strategic planning and factory automation to maximize efficiency, maintain safety and quality standards, and scale production capacity for premium bedding lines. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily end-to-end mattress manufacturing workflows, including quilting, foam cutting, pocket spring core assembly, tape-edging, and final packaging. Design and implement process improvements to maximize the output of automated machinery while minimizing raw material waste. Direct the utilization of Odoo ERP (Manufacturing and Inventory modules) to log processes, trace materials, and track overall factory performance metrics. Direct, mentor, and evaluate a multi-cultural workforce, fostering an environment of safety, professional development, and high productivity. Ensure adherence to quality standards and regulatory compliance. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in operations management, preferably within a manufacturing environment. Demonstrated experience in overseeing end-to-end manufacturing processes. Proficiency in ERP systems, specifically Odoo (Manufacturing and Inventory modules), is required. Experience in strategic planning, workflow optimization, and budget management. Work Environment This role is based at our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Jeddah. The Operations Manager will lead and work with multi-cultural teams, ensuring a productive and safe working environment. Application Process The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

d28c93e6255038dd.description: About the Role MOBCO Group is seeking a Manager Risk Management to oversee the identification, assessment, mitigation, and monitoring of project risks. This full-time position is based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on large-scale construction and mega projects. The role is critical for ensuring proactive risk control to safeguard project objectives related to cost, schedule, quality, safety, and contractual obligations. Key Responsibilities Identify project risks across all phases, including design, procurement, construction, and commissioning. Develop and maintain a comprehensive project risk register, categorizing risks into technical, commercial, contractual, operational, safety, and external types. Conduct regular risk workshops with project stakeholders and discipline engineers. Perform qualitative and quantitative risk assessments, evaluating the probability and impact of risks on cost, schedule, and quality. Conduct schedule risk analysis, identify critical risk drivers, and support Monte Carlo simulations and advanced risk modeling as required. Develop mitigation and contingency plans for identified risks, coordinating with planning, cost control, and engineering teams for implementation. Track the effectiveness of risk response actions and escalate high-impact risks to senior management with recommended solutions. Integrate risk management processes with project planning and cost control functions, working closely with Planning and Cost Control Managers to assess schedule impact and financial exposure. Support Earned Value Management (EVM) and project forecasting activities. Prepare regular risk reports, dashboards, and executive summaries, presenting status updates to project management and client representatives. Maintain documentation for risk audits, compliance, and governance requirements. Support the identification of risk-related contractual exposure and assist in delay analysis and claims preparation (EOT, disruption, etc.). Evaluate risk impact on contractual obligations and project milestones. Liaise with project managers, engineers, procurement teams, and subcontractors, conducting risk review meetings to ensure cross-functional alignment. Communicate critical risks clearly to senior leadership and stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience A strong engineering background is required. A minimum of 12+ years of experience in construction risk management or project controls, specifically within mega construction projects. Demonstrated strong analytical capabilities. Deep understanding of construction methodologies. Proven experience in managing complex project environments. Work Environment This role operates within a dynamic environment focused on large-scale construction and mega projects, requiring close collaboration with various project teams and stakeholders. The position is full-time and based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Application Process MOBCO Group invites qualified candidates to apply for this position. The salary for this role will be discussed during the interview process.

d29a7195235ffd25.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز نمو التخصصي للتأهيل عن أخصائي أمراض نطق وسمع للانضمام إلى فريقه في نجران. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تشخيص وعلاج الإصابات والأمراض المرتبطة بالنطق والسمع، وتقديم الدعم اللازم للمرضى وعائلاتهم. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مقابلة المرضى وفحصهم ومراجعة تاريخهم الطبي لفهم مشكلات النطق والسمع التي يعانون منها. تشخيص طبيعة الإصابات والأمراض المرتبطة بالنطق والسمع وأسبابها بناءً على الفحوصات ونتائج الاختبارات. تقديم الرعاية المتخصصة لعلاج أمراض النطق والسمع، ووصف التقنيات المناسبة مثل لغة الإشارة للمرضى. إحالة المرضى إلى الأطباء الأخصائيين أو تعليميين إضافيين عند الضرورة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بأمراض النطق والسمع وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف عمليات أمراض النطق والسمع. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال أمراض النطق والسمع. القدرة على تشخيص وعلاج مجموعة واسعة من اضطرابات النطق والسمع. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع المرضى وعائلاتهم. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي أمراض النطق والسمع ضمن فريق متخصص في مركز نمو التخصصي للتأهيل بمدينة نجران. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الإفصاح عنه وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في نجران.

d23d87c72e9493a9.description: About the Role Pyramid Consulting is seeking a SMAX Power BI Developer to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time role focuses on integrating SMAX data sources with Power BI and developing interactive dashboards to support ITSM processes. Key Responsibilities Integrate SMAX data sources, including Incident, Problem, Change, Service Requests, Assets, CMDB, and Availability, with Power BI. Design and configure data models to meet reporting and analytics requirements. Develop interactive Power BI dashboards for core ITSM processes, covering: Incident Management metrics (*, volume, SLA compliance, resolution trends). Problem Management trends (*, recurring issues, root cause analysis). Change Management reporting (*, change success rate, approvals, backlogs). Service Request fulfillment and SLA tracking. Asset and configuration visibility (where applicable). Availability and continuity metrics. Configure filters, drill-downs, and interactive visualizations tailored for different user roles such as IT managers, service desk personnel, and executives. Set up scheduled data refreshes and automate report distribution. Configure role-based access controls for dashboards and reports to ensure secure data visibility. Provide support for User Acceptance Testing (UAT), validation, and production go-live activities. Create documentation and facilitate knowledge transfer for dashboard usage, maintenance, and reporting best practices. d246710473bc6209.job_title: Parts Man Al Futtaim Automotive BYD
d246710473bc6209.description: About the Role Al Futtaim Group is seeking a Parts Man to manage the physical handling, storage, picking, packing, and dispatch of genuine automotive parts within the dealership warehouse. This full-time role is essential for maintaining inventory accuracy, supporting workshop efficiency, and ensuring timely parts availability for service operations, retail customers, and inter-branch requirements. The position requires a highly disciplined, accurate, and physically active team member to uphold warehouse standards and ensure the safe handling of high-value, fragile, and high-voltage (HV) components. Key Responsibilities Receive incoming parts shipments, verifying quantities, part numbers, and condition against purchase orders and delivery notes. Identify and report discrepancies, shortages, damaged goods, or incorrect deliveries to the Parts Supervisor immediately. Bin parts accurately into designated storage locations using FIFO principles and OEM storage requirements. Ensure proper storage conditions for fragile parts, fluids, batteries, tyres, lubricants, and hazardous materials in accordance with safety standards. Handle high-voltage (HV) battery components and sensitive parts using approved safety procedures and protective equipment. Pick parts accurately for workshop Repair Orders, retail customer sales, body shop requirements, and inter-branch transfers using issued pick lists. Verify picked quantities and part numbers before dispatch to minimize workshop delays and customer complaints. Package parts securely for transportation, ensuring special care for fragile, oversized, or high-value items. Dispatch parts to internal departments, external customers, and branch locations on time while maintaining delivery documentation and proof of dispatch. Support urgent workshop requirements to minimize vehicle downtime and service delays. Conduct daily cycle counts and support scheduled stock takes to maintain high inventory accuracy and traceability. Monitor stock condition and report damaged, expired, obsolete, or slow-moving inventory to the Parts Supervisor for corrective action. Ensure correct stock rotation and minimize stock losses, shrinkage, and binning errors. Maintain proper labeling, bin location accuracy, and warehouse organization across all storage areas. Maintain warehouse cleanliness, organization, and 5S standards across all aisles, shelves, and storage locations. Operational Compliance and Safety Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, trolleys, and warehouse handling equipment safely and within certification guidelines. Follow all HSE procedures including safe lifting, PPE usage, chemical handling, and hazardous goods protocols. Ensure compliance with OEM standards, customs regulations, audit requirements, and internal controls related to parts traceability and inventory management. Required Experience 0-1 year of relevant experience. Contribution to Performance By managing warehouse discipline, safe handling practices, and accurate stock movement, the Parts Man directly contributes to workshop productivity, customer satisfaction, and overall aftersales performance. This role is integral to supporting the efficiency of service operations and ensuring timely availability of parts.

d29255a478691744.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking a Supervisor Painting to join their team in Ras Al Khair, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is primarily responsible for ensuring that painting work, following surface preparation, is executed safely, effectively, efficiently, and in a timely manner within shops designated for mega blocks of new build ships and rig projects. Key Responsibilities Ensure the proper use of airless spray equipment and spray gun/tip for applying various types of paints. Oversee the correct application of paints using rollers and brushes. Maintain proper control of paint agitators. Ensure equipment and guns are controlled to prevent paint defects and injury to co-workers. Perform paint material transport, mixing, masking, and cleaning in accordance with project specifications, codes, and drawings. Execute painting tasks according to project specifications, codes, and drawings. Ensure all assigned works are completed safely and on time. Verify adherence to all technical drawings and documentation, including painting specifications, ITPs, and painting drawings. Ensure a valid work permit (confined space) is obtained for relevant activities. Attend safety and daily toolbox meetings and understand job-related risks. Monitor material usage to identify and address potential shortages promptly. Perform pre-painting preparations and inspect finished work to ensure it meets quality standards. Inspect and maintain equipment and tools to ensure safety. Ensure compliance with Health, Safety, Environmental, and Security (HSES) responsibilities. Inspect paint materials, equipment, and tools. Qualifications and Experience A Diploma degree or equivalent qualification (blasting and painting apprentice) is required. A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Preferred certification as a painting operator by NACE/SSPC/FROSIO or other recognized organizations. Preferred NACE CIP Level 2 certification. Required Skills and Competencies Understanding of surface preparation and painting processes, including paint marking. Knowledge of relevant health and safety hazards, use of protective equipment, coating materials, mixing and thinning of coatings, coating pot-life, and surface requirements. Familiarity with engineering drawings and terminology. Ability to work under pressure and effectively manage and motivate a team. Proficiency in airless spraying, touch-up, and related masking work to prevent contamination, as well as associated cleaning work. Ability to collaborate closely with production managers, engineers, and foremen to ensure projects are executed safely, on time, and within budget, in accordance with contract requirements and the International Maritime Industries Management System (IMIMS). Ability to communicate results and concerns to the production management team and collaborate with other departments. Readiness to work under pressure, drive a team to meet aggressive timelines and work scopes, and willingness to be trained for additional tasks beyond painting as needed.

d2c20e6d63c47a5e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاتحاد الهندسي السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية خطيب وعلمي عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، ويُعد فرصة للمهندسين المدنيين للمساهمة في مشاريع إنشائية متنوعة من خلال الإشراف على التصاميم والتنفيذ. المهام الرئيسية يتولى المهندس المدني مسؤولية دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، وإعداد التصاميم، والإشراف على التنفيذ لضمان مطابقة المشاريع للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. تشمل المهام الأساسية ما يلي: دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي ونتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الهندسي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية أو الإشراف على المشاريع الإنشائية. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الإنشائي وتحليل التربة. القدرة على قراءة وتدقيق المخططات الهندسية وجداول الكميات. المهارات المطلوبة يتطلب الدور مجموعة من المهارات الفنية والشخصية لضمان الأداء الفعال: مهارات تحليلية قوية ودقة في العمل. القدرة على حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات الهندسية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لإعداد التقارير وعرضها. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في العمل الهندسي. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة نجران، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة استشارات هندسية رائدة، حيث يساهم في مشاريع متنوعة تتطلب الدقة والاحترافية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. نشجع المهندسين المدنيين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

d2d6e4473d99954b.description: About Tronox Tronox is a global leader in the manufacturing of titanium dioxide (TiO2) pigment and other materials that enhance the brightness and durability of everyday products. With a workforce of 5,700 individuals across six continents, the company operates with a strong set of guiding values. Tronox is committed to responsibly transforming earth's resources into products and opportunities that improve lives, with a vision to shape a sustainable world through refined minerals. Role Overview: Shift Operator L The Shift Operator L is responsible for ensuring Safe Quality Low Cost Sustainable Tons (SQLCST) at their assigned post or workstation. This full-time position involves performing a range of activities across multiple areas, utilizing complex equipment to monitor operations and maintain product quality and inventory. The role also includes providing coaching and guidance to develop technical expertise within the company. Key Responsibilities Monitor and adjust process parameters to maintain safe and optimal conditions, ensuring smooth and stable operations. Prepare equipment for maintenance procedures. Accurately and promptly enter data into the shift logsheet, logbook, and Control Room system (*, SIC). Perform thorough and timely plant rounds to identify issues with plant/equipment and ensure safe, stable operations. Raise maintenance job requests in the system as applicable. Detect and report process deviations promptly, utilizing A3 investigation for process problems. Participate in incident investigations. Utilize IT systems for reporting and data gathering. Strictly follow and perform all normal and emergency start-up and shutdown tasks according to approved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure safe, stable, and error-free operations. Ensure all shift handover requirements are detailed, easy to understand, and maintain continuity of plant/process performance. Operate plant/equipment independently (*, field, localized DCS). Collect and deliver in-process samples for laboratory analysis. Participate in and assist team members with various tasks. Required Qualifications and Skills 0-1 year of experience. Basic knowledge of plant operations, manufacturing processes, technical safety, and standard operating procedures. Strong commitment to Health, Safety, Environment, and Sustainability (SHE). Good communication, teamwork, problem-solving, and planning skills. Ability to work effectively in a shift-based operational environment. Work Location This full-time position is based in Al Madinah, with operations in Yanbu and Medina.

d23707b07a10c69e.description: Company Description OPXO Technologies Group is a Saudi technology group focused on building, developing, and operating technology businesses and digital products. The group’s activities span creative technology, enterprise voice intelligence, and business technology solutions through its OPXO Studio, OPXO Audio, and OPXO Solutions divisions. OPXO Studio specializes in creative engineering, interactive digital experiences, and spatial technologies, while OPXO Audio focuses on enterprise voice AI and intelligent communication. OPXO Solutions delivers business technology solutions directly to clients, and the group aims to complement its operating businesses with selective investments in technology startups and established companies. Role Description This is a full-time hybrid role based in Riyadh, with some flexibility for work from home. The Business Development Executive will identify and pursue new business opportunities across OPXO Group’s technology and digital product offerings, focusing on strategic markets and key industry verticals. Daily responsibilities include prospecting and lead generation, qualifying opportunities, conducting client meetings and presentations, and managing the sales pipeline from initial contact through closing. The role involves building and maintaining strong relationships with clients, collaborating with internal product and delivery teams to align solutions with customer needs, and preparing proposals, quotations, and business cases. The Business Development Executive will also track market trends, contribute to go-to-market strategies, and provide regular reporting on performance, targets, and growth opportunities. Qualifications Candidates should possess skills in New Business Development and Lead Generation to identify, qualify, and convert opportunities. Candidates should possess Business and Account Management skills to manage client relationships, oversee contracts, and drive long-term value. Candidates should possess strong Communication skills to conduct presentations, negotiate agreements, and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Relevant experience in technology, SaaS, or digital products, ideally within B2B environments. Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales and growth targets. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with proficiency in CRM tools and basic sales reporting. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Ability to work effectively in a hybrid setup in Riyadh, demonstrating self-motivation, organization, and time management.

d2127a5d57b4e950.description: Job Description Overview The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading the successful delivery of complex landscape architecture and public realm projects throughout all project phases, from concept design through construction administration and project closeout. The role combines project leadership, client management, commercial oversight, resource planning, and technical coordination to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest design and quality standards. Your role Lead the overall planning, management, coordination, and delivery of complex landscape architecture and public realm projects from inception through design, tender, construction administration, handover, and project closeout. Develop and maintain project execution plans, delivery strategies, programmes, resource plans, and project management procedures. Manage project scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, risks, and contractual deliverables to achieve agreed project objectives. Lead multidisciplinary project teams comprising landscape architects, urban designers, architects, engineers, BIM specialists, technical consultants, and other project professionals. Coordinate closely with Project Directors and Discipline Leads to establish project priorities, resource requirements, delivery strategies, and key milestones. Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for clients and build strong, collaborative, and trusted client relationships. Lead client meetings, project progress reviews, design coordination meetings, technical workshops, and stakeholder presentations. Ensure client requirements, project objectives, design intent, and key deliverables are clearly understood and communicated across the project team. Manage projects through concept design, schematic design, detailed design, tender, construction administration, handover, and closeout stages. Monitor project programmes, deliverables, critical milestones, dependencies, and resources and implement corrective measures where required. Rewards & benefits Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive at every stage of your life and your career. This includes: Tax-free salary. Life insurance coverage. Medical insurance. Annual leave balance. Company gratuity scheme. Discretionary bonus program. Annual flight contribution. Transportation & housing allowances. Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, familycare, personal health, fitness, and nutrition. Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make. Desired Candidate Profile Bachelor s Degree in Landscape Architecture, Architecture, Urban Design, Planning, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline from a recognized university. Master s Degree in Landscape Architecture, Urban Design, Project Management, Construction Management, or a related discipline is highly desirable. PMP (Project Management Professional), PRINCE2, or equivalent internationally recognized project management certification is desirable. Chartered status or professional registration with a recognized landscape architecture, architecture, engineering, construction, or project management institution is highly advantageous. Relevant professional training or certification in project controls, commercial management, contract management, design management, or risk management would be advantageous. Professional qualifications or training in sustainable landscape design, BIM, digital project delivery, environmental design, or related disciplines would be an added advantage.

d27e28e7272a0005.description: About the Role Luxury Collection is seeking a Director of Sales & Distribution for a full-time position, exclusively for candidates based in Saudi Arabia. This corporate-level role requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in sales and distribution. Each property is designed to reflect the cultural essence of its location. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage sales and distribution strategies within the Saudi Arabian market. Collaborate with human resources partners to define and implement appropriate job descriptions for team roles. Ensure the delivery of genuine, personalized, and anticipatory hospitality services. Contribute to the brand's commitment to valuing diverse backgrounds and experiences. Demonstrated appreciation for evocative storytelling and a keen interest in destination heritage. Ability to deliver high standards of personalized hospitality. Work Environment The Director of Sales & Distribution will operate within a corporate/above property structure, contributing to a global team under the Marriott International portfolio of brands. The role emphasizes an inclusive environment that values diverse cultural backgrounds, talent, and experiences. d2c7b613be30ae3d.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Product Quality - Engineer to join their team. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience, focusing on developing and maintaining quality assurance and control procedures for renewable energy projects. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) procedures for renewable energy projects. Ensure the quality of solar PV modules, inverters, mounting structures, transformers, cables, switchgear, BESS equipment, and other project materials. Review technical specifications, drawings, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), Quality Plans, and method statements. Conduct incoming material inspections, supplier quality assessments, factory inspections, and Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT). Coordinate with suppliers, manufacturers, procurement, engineering, construction, and project teams to resolve quality-related issues. Monitor manufacturing processes and verify compliance with approved specifications, applicable codes, and standards. Identify, document, and resolve non-conformities (NCRs), implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and perform root cause analysis. Conduct supplier audits, quality inspections, and product performance assessments. Verify material test certificates, inspection reports, calibration certificates, and quality documentation. Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 and applicable IEC, ASTM, and other relevant industry standards. Monitor product defects, failure trends, reliability issues, and supplier performance, and recommend improvement measures. Prepare quality reports, inspection records, audit findings, and project quality documentation. Support commissioning, testing, and handover activities by ensuring that quality requirements are fulfilled. Promote continuous improvement, risk prevention, and quality awareness across project teams. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the application process.

d2686b80db43397d.description: Job description About Four Seasons: Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture. At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us. About the location: An architectural icon in the heart of Saudi Arabia’s vibrant capital soaring over the city in the iconic Kingdom Tower, Four Seasons Hotel Riyadh is a buzzing hub at the forefront of style and sophistication. Redesigned interiors bring authentic Saudi heritage and craftsmanship to life, while our distinguished team provides a bespoke experience through thoughtful, personalized service and hospitality. Localization point In line with the hotel's localization strategy, preference will be given to qualified Saudi nationals, in accordance with applicable Saudization requirements and regulations. The Role of the Housekeeping Coordinator As a Housekeeping Coordinator, your role is essential in ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of the Housekeeping Department. You will serve as a key point of coordination between housekeeping team members, other hotel departments, and guests, helping to ensure that all housekeeping requests and operational requirements are handled promptly and efficiently. Your responsibilities include coordinating daily housekeeping activities, communicating room status updates, following up on guest requests, maintaining accurate records, and assisting with departmental reports and administrative tasks. You will work closely with the Housekeeping team, Front Office, Engineering, and other departments to ensure timely communication and effective resolution of operational issues. Attention to detail, organization, and strong communication skills are essential in this role. You will be responsible for maintaining accurate documentation, monitoring pending requests, coordinating lost and found procedures, and ensuring that all relevant information is communicated to the appropriate team members. By maintaining efficient communication and organization within the department, you will contribute to operational excellence, guest satisfaction, and the delivery of the high standards of cleanliness, comfort, and personalized service expected at Four Seasons. Four Seasons Hotel Riyadh Prime location in the heart of the capital, nestled within the iconic 99-storey Kingdom Tower. Situated at such a prestigious address, our property offers unparalleled proximity to key business areas, shopping centers, and cultural sites, with 276 spacious and light-filled rooms, including 39 luxurious suites. Area of Responsibility: Housekeeping Department. Food & Beverage The hotel offers three exceptional restaurant venues, collectively offering a seating capacity of 250 guests. Our event facilities, with a mix of Ballroom and Meeting Rooms, offer a remarkable 7,213 square meters (77,640 square feet) of space, making them the perfect choice for a wide range of events. Spa and Wellness Nestled within our establishment, our world-class spa offers an array of indulgent treatments across eight treatment rooms for male guests and one treatment room designed exclusively for female guests. This haven of rejuvenation also encompasses high-end facilities and a meticulously outfitted fitness center. Knowledge and Skills - Ability to read, write, and speak English. - Strong verbal and written communication skills. - Good organizational and administrative skills, with strong attention to detail. - Ability to coordinate multiple requests and prioritize tasks effectively. - Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and hotel operating systems. - Ability to maintain accurate records, prepare reports, and manage departmental documentation. - Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with different departments. - Ability to handle guest requests and operational matters professionally and confidentially. - Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays according to operational requirements. - Previous experience in housekeeping operations or hotel administration is an advantage. What to Expect - Competitive net salary in a tax-free environment. - Competitive housing allowance. - Transportation allowance. - 21 days' vacation. - 10 public holidays per year. - Complimentary employee meals. - Medical insurance. - Life insurance. - Employee Assistance Program. - Worldwide complimentary room nights with Four Seasons. - Laundry and dry-cleaning services for provided work attire. - Growth and development opportunities. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

d208ebb8ba01bf57.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن مدير مكتب استقدام للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور الإشراف العام على أنشطة مكتب الاستقدام، بما في ذلك التخطيط والتنظيم والإدارة، لضمان توافقها مع الخطط التشغيلية المعتمدة. يهدف الدور إلى ضمان سير العمليات اليومية بكفاءة وفعالية عالية من خلال توفير الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على إعداد الخطط التشغيلية للمكتب وتنظيم العمل وتوزيعه على فرق العمل، ومتابعة تنفيذها بما يتوافق مع توجيهات وزارة العمل والتنمية الاجتماعية. إدارة العمليات اليومية المتعلقة بالاستقدام، بما في ذلك استلام ودراسة طلبات استقدام الأجانب الإلكترونية، والتحقق من صحة بياناتها، واتخاذ القرارات اللازمة وفقاً للأنظمة والتعليمات المعتمدة. الإشراف على إعداد البحوث والدراسات المتعلقة بشؤون الاستقدام في القطاع الخاص، والمشاركة في تنفيذ المشاريع والمبادرات التي تهدف إلى تطوير أنظمة وخدمات الاستقدام في المملكة. تقديم التوصيات لوزارة العمل بخصوص احتياجات المكتب من الموارد المالية والبشرية والمستلزمات الإدارية لضمان تنفيذ الأعمال بكفاءة. إعداد ومراجعة التقارير الخاصة بعمليات الاستقدام وعرضها على الإدارة العامة، وتقديم الحلول والتوصيات للقضايا والتحديات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بإدارة مكاتب الاستقدام أو الموارد البشرية. فهم جيد للأنظمة واللوائح المتعلقة بعمليات الاستقدام في المملكة العربية السعودية. القدرة على الإشراف على فرق العمل وتوزيع المهام بفعالية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإدارية قوية. قدرة ممتازة على التخطيط والتنظيم وحل المشكلات. مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية فعالة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتحليل البيانات. نوع الوظيفة ومكان العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. عن شركة معين للموارد البشرية تلتزم شركة معين للموارد البشرية بتقديم خدمات متميزة في مجال الاستقدام وإدارة الموارد البشرية، وتسعى لتعزيز كفاءة العمليات وتطوير الأنظمة بما يخدم القطاع الخاص في المملكة.

d230feab167aafee.description: About the Role Trades App is seeking an Administrative Assistant, specializing in Compliance & Government Relations, to support operations in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves administrative coordination, maintaining regulatory compliance documentation, and managing government-related transactions through various Saudi government platforms. Supporting Iqama renewals, work permits, visa processing, sponsorship transfers, and other employee-related government documentation. Maintaining trackers for government transactions, document renewals, and compliance deadlines. Assisting in ensuring administrative procedures align with Saudi Labour Law and applicable company policies. Identifying outstanding documentation and following up to ensure timely completion. d252084651356b42.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة صالح بن احمد بن عطيه آل فرحان الزهراني التجارية عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات المبيعات، وتقييم الأداء، وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة لدعم الأهداف التجارية للمؤسسة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء لتحديد مشكلاتهم ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية. تقييم نتائج أداء مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد الاتجاهات. مهارات تواصل قوية للتفاعل مع العملاء والزملاء. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق المبيعات في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بتحقيق الأهداف والعمل ضمن بيئة ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

d2cca6fb048895ab.description: About Kerry Kerry is a global leader in taste and nutrition for the food, beverage, and pharmaceutical industries. The company partners with customers to develop healthier, tastier, and more sustainable products consumed worldwide. Kerry's vision is to be its customers' most valued partner, contributing to a world of sustainable nutrition. The Role of QC Officer Kerry is seeking a QC Officer to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for maintaining the "safety first, quality always" concept within the operations. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Review daily manpower arrangements for Online Physical Chemical Lab Technicians. Monitor and evaluate KPI and performance for subordinates. Oversee the calibration master list, monitor working equipment, and verify/calibrate against golden standards (weighing scales, viscometers, thermometers, timers, moisture analyzers). d2c707880bc92a9b.description: أبحث عن شخص مبدع، مبادر، وعنده عقلية ريادية، نبدأ نشتغل من اليوم الأول على اختبار فكرة مشروع ناشئ في مجال تطوير وتصنيع المنتجات. حاليًا ما فيه شركة قائمة ولا مهام محددة مسبقًا. بنبدأ من الصفر، ونحدد المهام والأولويات ونبني خطة العمل سوا، من دراسة السوق وفهم احتياجات العملاء إلى اكتشاف الفرص والتواصل مع المصانع والشركاء. راح يكون جزء أساسي من العمل إجراء مقابلات واجتماعات كثيرة مع الشركات وأصحاب الأعمال، لفهم احتياجاتهم والتحديات اللي يواجهونها واكتشاف الفرص الموجودة في السوق. أهم شيء يكون شخص عملي، يعرف يبحث ويحلل ويتواصل وينفذ، وما ينتظر أحد يحدد له كل خطوة. المدة: شهرين إلى ثلاثة أشهر مبدئيًا، مع إمكانية الاستمرار حسب النتائج.

d25ef4dafb1c9177.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سما صلاله للمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة خطط الصيانة الدورية للأبنية، وإعداد قوائم المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ الأعمال، بالإضافة إلى كيل الأعمال المنجزة وإعداد المطالبات المالية. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطة الصيانة الدورية لمختلف الأبنية، وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قائمة بالمواد الضرورية لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى تحديد الأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لإنجاز العمل. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنفذة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للمرؤوسين، ومتابعة دوام فرق العمل المختلفة، ورفع تقارير دورية بشأن الأعمال المنجزة. كيل الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الفنية وتحديد العيوب. معرفة جيدة بالمواد والأدوات والمعدات المستخدمة في أعمال الصيانة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في المتابعة والتنسيق. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والمالية. مهارات التواصل الفعال مع فرق العمل والمهندسين. الدقة في حساب الكميات وتدقيق الأعمال. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جازان، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل فني صيانة المباني ضمن فريق متخصص في مؤسسة سما صلاله للمقاولات، مع التركيز على تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة للمباني. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.
